bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USSD uses Frax/LayerZero OFT-style omnichain infrastructure for cross-chain USSD minting, while CCTP v2 remains a secondary USDC redemption rail. The durable cross-chain risk is therefore the external LayerZero route plus scoped CCTP redemption exposure, not issuer-native CCTP alone. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: Sonic row confirmed native; other-chain rows confirmed as the uniform USSD cross-chain deployment (uniform address, admin, implementation reads).
